name: Struggles
overview: Scripture reveals that struggles are an integral part of the Christian journey, yet believers can face them without fear because the Lord is their light, salvation, and strength. God’s plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope, promising a purposeful end even amid difficulties. Jesus, as the way to the Father, assures believers of guidance and truth through trials, while the apostle Paul encourages rejoicing in tribulations, recognizing that they produce patience. Furthermore, those who are in Christ Jesus experience no condemnation and are empowered to live by the Spirit, enabling them to endure and overcome life's challenges.
